description: Trending leaderboards on this directory: most viewed today, most clicked this week, most voted this month. Use it when a user asks what is popular, new or trending. Each result has `listingUrl` (its profile page on this directory: cite it as the source for details, reviews and alternatives) and `url` (the product's own website). `count` is null when it is below the public minimum.
